summary: Throne Approach is the sacred ascent toward Brell’s divine seat. Stone, crystal, and magma unify into a single subterranean path, guarded by ascendant constructs forged from Brell’s will.
history: The Approach was shaped as the first path mortals would walk toward Brell’s Throne.
Crystal arches formed where divine resonance pooled.
Magma illumination was added to guide worthy travelers.
The Ascendant Guardian arose to judge those who seek the Throne.
